name: Hello Satsuriku World -Zero One-
source:
To punish juvenile delinquents who brutally murdered her sister, genius game maker made a perfect revenge plan... This is a text adventure game of Full-Voice, which uses various branch options to complete four different endings. Is it salvation or destruction that awaits the hero at last? That's a question.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1040610/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
为了惩罚残忍杀害妹妹的少年犯，天才游戏制作人制定了完美复仇计划……这是一款全语音文字冒险游戏，通过各种分支选项达成4种不同结局。英雄最后迎来的是救赎还是毁灭？答案由你决定。

[来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1040610/]Steam[/url]]
